class.name: robot_body_filter/DistanceFilterProcessor
class.description: A LiDAR processor that filters points based on their distance from the sensor origin. Points closer than min_distance or farther than max_distance are removed. Useful for removing noise near the sensor and limiting the processing range.

class.name: robot_body_filter/VoxelGridProcessor
class.description: A LiDAR processor that applies voxel grid downsampling to reduce point cloud density. This processor helps to reduce computational load while maintaining the general structure of the point cloud data. Configurable voxel sizes in X, Y, and Z directions.

class.name: robot_body_filter/RobotBodyFilterProcessor
class.description: A LiDAR processor that removes the robot's own body from sensor data. This processor wraps the existing RobotBodyFilter functionality in the plugin interface, allowing it to be used as part of a processing pipeline. Supports both point clouds and laser scans with URDF-based robot model filtering.
